\tabnotes{Pooled $R^{2}_{\mathrm{oos}}$
  \eqref{eq:meth-ctr2} of the fully-recursive factor forecast against the
  recursive prevailing mean, with the entire factor chain---the cycle
  decomposition, the predictive regression, and the benchmark---rebuilt under
  each estimation scheme. Expanding windows use all history up to $t$ with a
  three-, five-, or seven-year training minimum; rolling windows use only the
  most recent ten or fifteen years. Each scheme scores its factor against the
  prevailing mean built under the same scheme, so columns are internally
  consistent; the expanding/five-year column reproduces the baseline of
  \Cref{tab:rob-sub-oos}. The global cycle factor's edge is invariant to the
  training-minimum length but is specific to the expanding window.}
